name: Droost Canvas
description: Drupal Canvas (Experience Builder) support for AI agents: component registry and lint, component_tree read/validate/write, and orchestration introspection of canvas_ai and ai_agents — exposed as MCP tools. Submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost Canvas adds Drupal Canvas (Experience Builder) support to Droost's MCP surface so an AI agent can work with Canvas component trees. It exposes seven MCP tools: an orientation status snapshot (droost_canvas_status), the placeable-component registry (droost_canvas_components), an SDC lint against Canvas requirements (droost_canvas_component_lint), read/validate/write of an entity's component_tree field (droost_canvas_tree_get, droost_canvas_tree_validate, droost_canvas_tree_set), and an orchestration map of the AI instruments available via canvas_ai and ai_agents (droost_canvas_orchestration). All but the writer are read-only; the writer (droost_canvas_tree_set) replaces an entity's tree and is gated by allow_entity_write and CLI-only. A TreeManager service centralises tree read/serialize/validate logic. It depends on the Droost base module and the Canvas module. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release.
